title: Monitoring Anything milestone template
description: Built-in templates live in System/profiles/milestones/builtin, user templates in System/profiles/milestones/user. Applied by `milestones apply` (or connect --milestone-template); tasks use the Connector milestoneTask format and are appended idempotently to Projects/<id>/Project.md.

appliesTo.description: Project types the UI should offer this template for.

mode.description: per-section needs a collected paper snapshot; static adds plain tasks.

groupBy.description: root: tasks go under a '### <top-level section>' heading inside ## Milestones.
